# Selected original dsh-context dashboard

Public source: [bowenliang123/dsh-context](https://github.com/bowenliang123/dsh-context/tree/2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499), version **0.68.1**, commit **2c8095c34da3fcef729a01437d2df65c83e08499**. Original **Copyright 2025 bowenliang123** and [Apache 2.0](LICENSE) apply to the selected supplier files. The inspected commit has no separate NOTICE file. They are not MIT and Augmentor’s resale restriction does not replace their licence.

SOURCE.json records every selected file’s original/adapted SHA-256. The preceding pre-sidebar selection contained ninety-nine files and twelve marked presentation adaptations; its changes were: disable automatic registry checks and an unbound DSH settings shortcut, remove an unattested DSH compaction threshold, mark unobserved skill/fleet data unavailable, and bind the original request selector to explicit Pi metadata paging/body reads with unavailable-data notes. The original slash modal also receives the same picker and a recorded-data notice. The original Insights overview uses independently authored bounded Pi corpus reads, keeps calendar/range/search/sort/group/paging/navigation/chart/heatmap structure, displays reported SDK usage buckets instead of inferred historical composition, disables DSH backfill and marks unavailable skills/prices/detailed timing explicitly. The tooltip captures stable identity outside React state updaters to prevent heatmap focus/measurement loops; its original markup and CSS remain unchanged. The original settings card accepts a supported-field gate so unconnected Pi controls remain visible but disabled; private display preferences use the existing Pi settings protocol. Cards, charts, browser, dialog interactions and CSS retain the supplier structure. Unused selected modules never enter the browser graph.

Build-time module resolution binds historyPage and modelPrices to independently authored read-only Pi glue. Inline projections supply retained Pi observations; there is no supplier plugin Host, Cordis runtime, extra agent/session loop, external price/registry fetch or DSH history route in the browser graph. Tailwind 4.3.3 generates the supplier utility CSS using the original source and pinned build-only compiler; its MIT notice is included separately in the bundled notices.

See [qualification and coverage](../../../../docs/DSH-GUI-ON-PI.md#original-context-dashboard--october-11-follow-up) and [private preferences](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-PREFERENCES.md). The Context tab and original slash modal share read-only Pi projections. The preceding qualification connected Context Insights and seven display fields while sidebar placement remained unported. The sidebar follow-up below supersedes that placement status; Fleet, prompt wrapping and delegated-child attribution remain unported.

The Context sidebar follow-up adds verbatim placement.ts and binds original sidebar.ts to the copied MIT registry. Selection is 100 files: 87 verbatim / 13 marked adaptations. services.ts adds an optional scroll prop; the already adapted contextView.tsx binds separate dock-occurrence scroll ledgers/root geometry and requires a served family face before offering family navigation. Its original structure/icons/CSS and every licence body remain preserved. All other supplier bodies remain unchanged. Placement becomes the eighth display field. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-SIDEBAR.md).

The original Fleet follow-up selects seven additional public files and reuses its graph/inspector/roster/comms widgets and CSS. Current selection is **107 files: 91 verbatim / 16 marked adaptations**. Original fleetTab/toggleGate registrations use UI-only slots; FleetView adds an optional scoped detail cache, fleetDetail adds optional scoped reader/invalidation seats, and agentTree accepts optional reported request/disposition and composition-availability fields to avoid inferred success or zero occupancy. The already adapted Context view requires an actually served catalogue for family navigation. Pi bindings read exact-parent saved jobs, worker histories and a bounded newest recorded body; child links use the same original DSH shell under narrower read-only authority. Team coordination, mailbox/relay records and full active-time data remain unavailable. No supplier Host or backend owner is mounted. Original licensing/icons/CSS remain preserved. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-FLEET.md).

The prompt-wrapping follow-up selects the verbatim public src/host/promptInjection.ts registration, bringing the selection to **108 files: 92 verbatim / 16 marked adaptations**. A separately verified single-source Node transpilation has no runtime imports; its Apache-2.0 licence and source record accompany the compiled module. An authored Pi context_with_system registry seat executes that function, reads the private preference revision once per conversational request, preserves existing content blocks/sections/tool declarations and native originals, and captures the applied text/revision through the bounded existing provenance path. Whitespace-only sections remain disabled and {{variables}} stay literal, using the original supplier callbacks. The original settings card and CSS are unchanged; eleven controls are connected, including the two bounded text fields. Standalone prompt-improvement and summary requests have separate instructions. Earlier unported prompt-wrapping statements describe their historical checkpoints. [Scope and qualification](../../../../docs/CONTEXT-PROMPT-WRAPPING.md).
